# FreeSurf Post — API Reference

Base URL: https://post.freesurf.tools

Free, open-source cross-posting API. Publish to X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram,
Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Bluesky from your own apps. Posting and analytics
are proxied through Bundle.social, so you don't manage platform credentials.

> This file and the in-app API tab (dashboard → API) are the source of truth.
> `archive/API_REFERENCE.md` is the old, superseded doc.

## Authentication

Two ways to authenticate:

1. **API key** (recommended for apps): send `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_...`
   or `FSP-API-KEY: fsp_live_...`. Generate and revoke keys in the dashboard
   (API tab). Keys are scoped to your account.
2. **Supabase JWT**: the dashboard's own session token (`Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`).

## Endpoints

- [Post now](#post-now) — `POST /api/post`
- [Schedule](#schedule) — `POST /api/schedule`
- [Scheduled posts](#scheduled-posts) — `GET /api/scheduled`, `DELETE /api/scheduled/:id`
- [Delete a published post](#delete-a-published-post) — `POST /api/posts/delete`
- [Metrics](#metrics) — `GET /api/metrics/:platform/:postId`
- [Analytics](#analytics) — `GET /api/analytics/:platform`, `POST /api/analytics/refresh`, `POST /api/analytics/force`
- [Media](#media) — `POST /api/media/upload`, `POST /api/media`
- [Comments & replies](#comments--replies) — `POST /api/comments/import`, `GET /api/comments`, `POST /api/reply`
- [Import post history](#import-post-history) — `POST /api/import`, `GET /api/imports`, `GET /api/imports/posts`
- [Posts & accounts](#posts--accounts) — `GET /api/posts/recent`, `GET /api/post/:id`, `GET /api/profiles`, `POST /api/disconnect/:platform`, `POST /api/channel/:platform`
- [Teams](#teams) — `GET /api/teams`, `POST /api/teams`, `PATCH /api/teams/:id`, `DELETE /api/teams/:id`
- [API keys](#api-keys) — `GET /api/keys`, `POST /api/keys`, `DELETE /api/keys/:id`

## Post now

`POST /api/post`

A team is required — target it either by **name** (`team`) or **id** (`teamId`).
`team` names are unique per account. Use whichever is easier; `teamId` wins if both are sent.

By team name:

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x", "linkedin"],
  "text": "Hello world",
  "mediaUrls": [],
  "team": "Personal"
}
```

By team id:

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x", "linkedin"],
  "text": "Hello world",
  "mediaUrls": [],
  "teamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6"
}
```

- `team` (required unless `teamId`): your team's name (e.g. `"Personal"`, `"citywallz"`).
- `teamId` (required unless `team`): internal team id (from `GET /api/teams`).
- `platforms` (required): array of platform keys (see [Platform keys](#platform-keys)).
- `text` (required): post body.
- `mediaUrls` (optional): Bundle upload ids (from `POST /api/media/upload` or `POST /api/media`).
- `platformTargets` (optional): per-platform target, required for some platforms — `{"discord":"channelId","slack":"channelId","pinterest":"boardName","reddit":"r/example"}`.
- `instagramImageFit` (optional): `"fit"` (default — adds padding) or `"crop"` (center-crops)
  so Instagram feed images outside 4:5–1.91:1 still publish. Applies to image posts only.

Response: `{ "id": "...", "results": [{ "platform": "x", "success": true, "postId": "...", "postUrl": "..." }], "postedAt": "..." }`

## Schedule

`POST /api/schedule`

A team is required, same as Post now — by name (`team`) or id (`teamId`).

```json
{
  "platforms": ["x"],
  "text": "Later post",
  "scheduledAt": "2026-08-31T14:00:00Z",
  "team": "Personal"
}
```

- `scheduledAt` (required): future ISO 8601 timestamp.
- Posts publish within ~5 minutes of that time via a cron worker, to the team
  stored on the post (never an active-team fallback).

## Scheduled posts

`GET /api/scheduled` — list your scheduled posts.
`DELETE /api/scheduled/:id` — cancel a scheduled post.

## Delete a published post (developer / API only)

`POST /api/posts/delete` — deletes a post already published to a platform.
Currently supports X (Bundle's metered tweet delete, **$0.01** each from credits).
Not exposed in the UI because it's irreversible.

```json
{ "platform": "x", "postId": "<post-id>" }
```

`postId` is the per-platform id recorded when the post was created — the value
in `results[].postId` (from `POST /api/post` or `GET /api/posts/recent`).

## Metrics

`GET /api/metrics/:platform/:postId` — engagement metrics for one published post.

`postId` is the per-platform post id recorded when the post was created — the
value in `results[].postId` from `POST /api/post`, or from `GET /api/posts/recent`.
Metrics are proxied from Bundle.social, so no platform credentials are needed
(works for X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, and Bluesky).

```
GET /api/metrics/x/<postId>
```

Response:

```json
{
  "platform": "x",
  "postId": "...",
  "impressions": 23,
  "views": 0,
  "likes": 2,
  "comments": 1,
  "shares": 0,
  "clicks": 0
}
```

Auth: API key or JWT. X metric reads are metered (~$0.005/read) from credits.

## Analytics

Raw Bundle analytics plus refresh/aggregate helpers. Auth: API key or JWT.

- `GET /api/analytics/:platform?type=profile` — profile metrics (followers, reach, …). Default `type=profile`.
- `GET /api/analytics/:platform?type=post&postId=<postId>` — raw Bundle post analytics (includes `externalData` with the native post id/permalink).
- `POST /api/analytics/refresh?limit=10` — pull fresh analytics for the caller's recent posted posts and cache them into `post_posts.metrics`. Returns `{ refreshed, posts }`.
- `POST /api/analytics/force` — force a single live fetch. Body `{ "platform": "x", "postId": "..." }` for app posts, or `{ "platform": "x", "importedPostId": "..." }` for imported posts.
- `GET /api/analytics` — aggregate totals per platform for the last 30 days: `{ analytics, totals, period }`.

```
GET /api/analytics/x?type=profile
GET /api/analytics/instagram?type=post&postId=xxx
POST /api/analytics/refresh?limit=10
```

## Media

`POST /api/media/upload` — upload a local file (multipart, field `file`), returns `{ "uploadId": "..." }`.
`POST /api/media` — upload from a public URL: `{ "url": "https://example.com/photo.jpg" }` → `{ "uploadId": "..." }`.

Then pass the upload ids in `mediaUrls` on `POST /api/post`. `text` is the caption.
Pass multiple ids for carousels (X, LinkedIn, Instagram). TikTok and YouTube require
a single video. Supported types: jpg / jpeg / png / gif / mp4 / mov / pdf.

## Comments & replies

Pull comments on one of your posts, then reply to a specific comment.

```
# 1) Import comments (async — poll /api/comments until they appear)
POST /api/comments/import   { "platform": "x", "postId": "<postId>" }

# 2) List the fetched comments (id, authorName, text, publishedAt)
GET /api/comments?platform=x&postId=<postId>

# 3) Reply to a comment (commentId from step 2)
POST /api/reply   { "platform": "x", "postId": "<postId>", "commentId": "<commentId>", "text": "Thanks!" }
```

`postId` is the per-platform id of the original post (from `results[].postId` or
`GET /api/posts/recent`). Replying posts live and is metered like a post on X
($0.015 plain, $0.20 with a link). Works on X and Bluesky.

## Import post history

Backfill posts a connected account published **before** it was connected (async
job) — useful for X, whose per-post analytics aren't served passively. Imported
posts come back with their analytics where the platform reports them. Supports
`x`, `bluesky`, `threads`, `tiktok`, `linkedin`, `instagram`, `facebook`,
`pinterest`, `youtube`, `reddit`, `mastodon`.

```
POST /api/import          { "platform": "x", "count": 50, "withAnalytics": true }
GET  /api/imports?platform=x
GET  /api/imports/posts?platform=x&count=50
```

`count` defaults to 50. Monthly import caps apply; the posts endpoint returns
`remainingCapacity`. Imports are billed at $0.005 per result. Refresh only pulls
**live** metrics for posts this app published — use import for older posts.

## Posts & accounts

- `GET /api/posts/recent?limit=10` — your recent posted posts with per-platform `results[]` (each has `postId`, `postUrl`, `success`) and cached `metrics`.
- `GET /api/post/:id` — one post's status and `externalData` (native ids/permalinks). JWT only.
- `GET /api/profiles` — connected platform profiles for the current user.
- `GET /api/connect/:platform` — Bundle portal URL to connect an account.
- `POST /api/disconnect/:platform` — disconnect a connected account.
- `POST /api/channel/:platform` — set / refresh / unset the target channel/page (Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Reddit, Discord, Slack, Pinterest).
- `GET /api/bundle-accounts` — list Bundle-connected accounts.
- `GET /api/bundle-posts?platform=<platform>` — recent Bundle posts.

## Teams

`GET /api/teams` — list your teams (id, label, is_active).
`POST /api/teams` — create a team (`{ "label": "Personal" }`). Labels are unique
per account; a duplicate returns `409`.
`PATCH /api/teams/:id` — rename a team (`{ "label": "..." }`).
`DELETE /api/teams/:id` — delete a team.

Target a specific team when posting with `team` (by name) or `teamId` (by id):

```json
{ "platforms": ["x"], "text": "For my business", "team": "citywallz" }
```

```json
{ "platforms": ["x"], "text": "For my business", "teamId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6" }
```

## API keys

`GET /api/keys` — list your keys (metadata only, never the secret).
`POST /api/keys` — create a key (`{ "name": "..." }`); returns the raw key once.
`DELETE /api/keys/:id` — revoke a key.

## Platform keys

| Key       | Platform   |
|-----------|------------|
| `x`       | X / Twitter |
| `linkedin`| LinkedIn   |
| `facebook`| Facebook   |
| `instagram` | Instagram |
| `threads` | Threads    |
| `tiktok`  | TikTok     |
| `youtube` | YouTube    |
| `bluesky` | Bluesky    |
| `reddit` | Reddit     |
| `pinterest` | Pinterest    |
| `slack` | Slack    |
| `discord` | Discord    |
| `google_business` | Google Business    |

## Credits / X fees

`GET /api/credits` — balance (`balanceMicros`) and recent transactions.
`POST /api/credits/topup` — `{ "amountCents": 500 }` → Stripe Checkout, returns `{ "url": "…" }`.
`POST /api/credits/webhook` — Stripe webhook; credits the ledger on payment success.

X is metered: **$0.015** per plain/media post, **$0.20** for a post with a link.
Each successful X post is debited from your balance automatically.

## Notes

- **Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube** publish to a selected Page/Channel. Select it in
  the dashboard Accounts tab (or via `POST /api/channel/:platform`) before posting;
  otherwise the post may go to a default target or fail.
- **Instagram** feed images default to `autoFitImage` (padding). Pass
  `instagramImageFit: "crop"` in the post body to center-crop instead.
- **TikTok and YouTube** require a video; **Instagram** accepts images or video.
- **Reddit, Pinterest, Slack, Discord, Google Business** can be connected in the
  dashboard Accounts tab. Posting requires a target per platform — send
  `platformTargets` like `{ "discord": "channelId", "slack": "channelId",
  "pinterest": "boardName", "reddit": "r/example" }`.

## Common errors

- **`{"error":"Invalid JSON body"}` (400)** — client-side quoting problem. PowerShell
  5.1 corrupts embedded quotes when `-d` is passed as an argument: pipe the body via
  stdin (`-d "@-"`) or write it to a file (`-d @body.json`). Keep captions ASCII;
  emoji/non-ASCII in a PowerShell `-d` argument mangles the JSON too.
- **`{"error":"teamId or team is required"}` (400)** — every post/schedule needs a
  team by name (`"team": "Personal"`) or id (`"teamId": "..."`); list via `GET /api/teams`.
- **`401 Unauthorized`** — missing, revoked, or wrong-position API key. Send
  `Authorization: Bearer fsp_live_...` or `FSP-API-KEY: fsp_live_...`.
- **`{"error":"Unsupported file type"}` (400)** on upload — extension not supported
  (jpg/jpeg/png/gif/mp4/mov/pdf). Type is inferred from the filename.
- **X `Insufficient X credit`** — X is metered ($0.015 plain, $0.20 with a link);
  top up in the X fees tab.
- **Comment create `Request Validation Error` (400)** — a required field is missing
  (commonly the post id); the error names the missing field.
- **`{"error":"Unknown platform"}` (400)** — platform key not supported (see Platform keys).
